Fictional research page

This page describes a fictional register of ME/CFS research projects and explains in plain words who runs it and what it lists. The register is open to read for everyone.

The page also has a contact form for general questions about the fictional register, and the form carries a captcha setting that is only in the page source, never in the visible text.

Researchers can read the list of projects without an account. This paragraph and the ones above it add up to far more than two hundred characters, but still fewer than a thousand, to test that the markers in code and settings do not make a real page look blocked.
